title: 第7章 故人来信
novel_title: 长生修仙，从装备土龙鳞开始
content_zh:
遁入土石后，林玄心头骤然一紧。

    四周一片昏暗，就连方向感也变得有些模糊。

    不过这种不适只持续了一息。

    很快林玄便稳住心神，借着脑海中的山川地脉图重新辨明方向，然后径直朝地下深处遁去。

    数息之后，林玄眼前忽然一亮，感应到了前方那几道浓郁的灵机。

    也就在此时，地行符的力量逐渐耗尽，林玄的身形也在土石之中显现出来。

    沉重的泥土顿时从四面八方挤压而来，压得他胸口发闷，连呼吸都变得有些艰难。

    林玄不敢耽搁，立刻取出一柄铁铲，迅速开始挖起周围的土石。

    至于被挖开的土石，则是被他收进了储物袋中。

    片刻后，一个勉强容身的小洞被林玄挖了出来。

    紧接着他又取出一把铁镐，开始挖掘起下方的岩层。

    岩层比寻常泥土坚硬许多，哪怕林玄以灵力灌注铁镐，也挖得颇为艰难。

    足足过了一个时辰，脚下岩层才终于被他挖开一片。

    林玄低头看去，眼中闪过一丝喜色。

    只见那处新挖出的岩坑之中，正裸露着三块拳头大小的紫金色矿石。

    这矿石通体紫金，表面有细密天然纹路，隐隐泛着金属光泽。

    即便埋在岩层深处多年，仍有一缕锋锐而沉凝的灵气在其表面缓缓流转。

    “一阶上品灵矿，紫金石。”

    “每块至少值一百块灵石！”

    林玄定了定神，强行压下心头激动，挥动铁镐，将周围岩层一点点剥开。

    两刻钟后，三块紫金石被完整取下。

    林玄没有多看，立刻取出玉匣，将三块紫金石分别封好，收入储物袋中。

    做完这些，他并未急着离开。

    而是先将方才收入储物袋中的泥土重新倒出，一点点填回原处。

    做完这一切后，林玄这才取出一张新的地行符。

    灵力注入。

    土黄色光芒再次将他包裹。

    三息之后，林玄身形一轻，重新从地下遁出，回到了那处岩壁前。

    脚踩在松软松针上的一瞬间，林玄才真正松了口气，他心念一动。

    “清洁术。”

    下一刻，一层淡淡灵光自他身上拂过，泥土、石屑以及汗意尽数消散。

    林玄又从储物袋中取出一件干净衣袍换上。
content_en:
After escaping into the earth and rocks, Lin Xuan's heart suddenly tightened.

    It was dark all around, and even the sense of direction became a little blurry.

    But the discomfort only lasted for a breath.

    Lin Xuan quickly calmed down, re-identified the direction with the help of the mountains and rivers map in his mind, and then escaped deep underground.

    After a few breaths, Lin Xuan's eyes suddenly lit up, and he sensed the strong spiritual energy in front of him.

    At this time, the power of the earth talisman was gradually exhausted, and Lin Xuan's figure also appeared in the earth and stone.

    The heavy soil suddenly squeezed in from all directions, making his chest feel tight and even breathing became a little difficult.

    Lin Xuan did not dare to delay, so he immediately took out a shovel and quickly began to dig up the surrounding earth and rocks.

    As for the excavated earth and rocks, he put them into storage bags.

    After a while, Lin Xuan dug out a small hole that could barely fit in.

    Then he took out an iron pickaxe and began to dig out the rock formation below.

    The rock formation was much harder than ordinary soil. Even if Lin Xuan poured his spiritual power into the iron pickaxe, it would be quite difficult to dig.

    After a full hour, he finally dug out a piece of the rock beneath his feet.

    Lin Xuan looked down, a hint of joy flashing in his eyes.

    I saw three fist-sized pieces of purple-gold ore exposed in the newly dug rock pit.

    This ore is entirely purplish gold, with fine natural textures on its surface and a faint metallic sheen.

    Even though it has been buried deep in the rock formations for many years, there is still a sharp and condensed spiritual energy slowly flowing on its surface.

    "First-grade high-grade spiritual mineral, purple gold stone."

    "Each piece is worth at least a hundred spiritual stones!"

    Lin Xuan calmed down, suppressed the excitement in his heart, and swung the pickaxe to peel off the surrounding rock formations bit by bit.

    Two quarters of an hour later, the three purple gold stones were completely removed.

    Lin Xuan didn't look much, and immediately took out the jade box, sealed the three purple gold stones separately, and put them into the storage bag.

    After doing this, he was not in a hurry to leave.

    Instead, pour out the soil that you just put into the storage bag and fill it back into the original place bit by bit.

    After doing all this, Lin Xuan took out a new Earth Talisman.

    Infusion of spiritual power.

    Earthy yellow light enveloped him again.

    After three breaths, Lin Xuan's body lightened up, he escaped from the ground again, and returned to the rock wall.

    The moment his feet stepped on the soft pine needles, Lin Xuan truly breathed a sigh of relief, and a thought came to his mind.

    "Cleaning Technique."

    The next moment, a layer of faint spiritual light swept over his body, and all the dirt, stone chips, and sweat dissipated.

    Lin Xuan took out another clean robe from his storage bag and put it on.
title_en: Chapter 7 Letter from an Old Friend
